notes.title: Released now - Tips Here!
notes.content:
[b]SUPPORTED CANASTA VARIATIONS[/b]
- default rules are mainly based on Whist Club
- specify variations by clicking [i][b]Rules[/b][/i] or [i][b]Scoring[/b][/i] button on top

[b]TUTORIAL[/b]
- click [i][b]Extras[/b][/i] > [i][b]Tutorial[/b][/i] in main menu to learn Canasta rules

[b]FEEL FREE[/b]
- to discuss rule variations or anything!

Details concerning game's basic rules you find in help: click [i][b]Help[/b][/i] button in the menu. If you wish other rules, let us know and discuss. We'll evaluate and expand the game!
